name: @doenet/doenetml-worker-cells
description: Prototype DoenetML core organized around a flat list of f64 cells (Rust, compiled to WASM)

scripts.test: npm run test:before && cargo test --workspace && echo 'tests complete (keep this message at the end of the tests)'

build:wasm.command: npx wasm-pack build crates/cells-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../web/src/wasm --out-name cells_wasm

test:before.//: cargo test parses DoenetML through scripts/parse-dast.mjs, which needs the built parser.
